_: The glitch range's looks. One entry per look; the phone looks each have src/looks/<id>.css, loaded on demand. Add a look = a file + an entry; replace one = swap its file, keep its id. shape picks the picker card's miniature: page | sheet | device | dock. padAlwaysOut: the on-screen pad is part of the body, never folded. The touch-screen default is data-look-touch on <html> in glitch.html.
